items.title: Albert Nicholas Interview, 1967-02-09
items.q: And Bill Davidson was on that program. And Louis played two, three numbers with the group, with our regular group.

ctx.x: And to think that Louis could go here.

Oh man, Louis blew them all into bad health. I remember one time in New York on Rudy Blesher's program, This Is Jazz, and Louis was a guest star for that Saturday. And Bill Davidson was on that program. And Louis played two, three numbers with the group, with our regular group. And when Pops took over, Bill Davidson sounded like a little boy amateur. And he couldn't play it no more the rest of the evening. He was so nervous. Because he didn't have the sound. The master was there, man. That's something else. You…
Could I ask you, Albert, you heard Buddy Bolden when you were a child. And I wonder if you could remember at all how he sounded and how the band played.
